items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And what was Lee Collins playing at the time? Trumpet.

ctx.x: Yeah. You were just asking about Arthur Williams. About Arthur who? Arthur Williams.
Arthur Williams. Oh, I see. That's his name. Good. And what was Lee Collins playing at the time? Trumpet. And Bud Russel?
Page 5. Did you use a piano in the band? No, there wasn't any piano. Only when we get a job where the piano was, it was either high. It's different piano players. No.
